title: Why Your Day Is Secretly Getting Shorter
hook: Your day just got shorter, and nobody actually knows why.
closing: Your day is shrinking, and the data proves it.
question: Feel days speeding up? Comment below.

segments.say: The 2024 day ran 1.66 milliseconds shorter than usual, getting shorter nearly every year.
Since 1972, 27 leap-second corrections have been added to match the shorter day, and none have ever been removed.
Scientists put the odds of needing to reverse a second by 2035, for the first time ever, at 40 percent.
